people.name: Adonijah
people.line: Son of David who attempted to seize the throne

people.name: Bathsheba
people.line: Wife of Uriah, later married David and bore Solomon.

people.name: David
people.line: Anointed king of Israel, ancestor of Jesus Christ

people.name: Haggith
people.line: One of David's wives; mother of Adonijah.

people.name: Nathan
people.line: Prophet during the reigns of David and Solomon.

people.name: Solomon
people.line: Son of David, king of Israel, known for his wisdom.

translations.web: Then Nathan spoke to Bathsheba the mother of Solomon, saying, “Haven’t you heard that Adonijah the son of Haggith reigns, and David our lord doesn’t know it?
translations.bsb: Then Nathan said to Bathsheba the mother of Solomon, “Have you not heard that Adonijah son of Haggith has become king, and our lord David does not know it?
translations.kjv: Wherefore Nathan spake unto Bathsheba the mother of Solomon, saying, Hast thou not heard that Adonijah the son of Haggith doth reign, and David our lord knoweth it not?
translations.asv: Then Nathan spake unto Bath-sheba the mother of Solomon, saying, Hast thou not heard that Adonijah the son of Haggith doth reign, and David our lord knoweth it not?
